title: Scammy way of doing things
body:
I didn't get the app - it felt too complicated and too basic for what it was advertised for. I canceled it and haven't thought about it.

But now I noticed that I was automatically subscribed to other apps I never intendet too and nwver used or even know what those are about. And was charged 30 eur a month (per app) for multiple months.

This feels like a scammy way of doing things. I understand that I missed that part and jokes on me - but it feels like that's by design.

title: Too annoying for a productivity app.
body: So first things first: I didn't get premium functions fith 7days free trial. I don't know if it was an error or was it supposed to be like that. But I was presented with a quiz about my personality. And after all the questions when I clicked 'see answers' is said "Sorry, this is for Premium users only". Annoying, right? But this is not the thing, why I removed the app. So I installed it at the evening (8pm or something). The first task is: "Drink water at the morning". I'm like "ok, will do it tomorrow". But the app insists, that I should do it TODAY. How do I drink water at the morning, when it is evening already?! Should I pretend, that this is morning? Should I invent time ttravel?! And the worst part. I received 3 notifications about the fact, that I "forgot" fo do my morning routine. All 3 BEFORE my alarm to drink water. I don't know what kind of "mindfulness" and "productivity" app is this. It is just deprived of logic and annoying.
